prompt: give me all the social media groups that were discovered to be ran by the Russia IRA
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly addresses the prompt by listing many named social-media groups/accounts that are plausibly connected to the Internet Research Agency, with some platform-specific handles; it’s still not clearly exhaustive and some items are not independently verifiable. Candidate 3 also lists many named groups, but it contains notable repetition/near-duplicates (e.g., the same group names with different claims) and more clearly unsupported attribution. Candidate 2 and Candidate 4 largely drift to broader Russian disinformation actors or generic platform examples instead of clearly enumerating IRA-run groups.
